what: The signed sev runbooks plan needed five corrections in its slice B1, written in pull request 1646's body: R10's no-run-rerun rule and its test left B1, because .oxlintrc.json and oxlint-plugins/README.md are held by open pull requests 1648 and 1497; the three glossary rows left too, because .glossary/TERMS.md is held by open pull request 1638; the lead skill's step 9 admin-merge sentence was a home of decision 0611's rule and was not in the Files table, so B1 edits it; and the plan's Route.admin had no way to tell a sev0 fix from a plain allowed pull request, so it gained sev0Fixes, read from open --allow and next lines; and sev-ci-is-slow.md leaves B1, since the review found no recorded response to the speed issue (1333 opened 2026-11-15, not 2026-11-17), so 0571's binding line, no runbook before its operation ran for real, holds it back until a speed sev1 is worked and written up.
cause: The plan's Files table was read against main, not against the files open pull requests already held, and against the code homes of the rules it moved, not every prose home.
fix: A plan's draft check could list each Files row that an open pull request also changes, and each prose line elsewhere that repeats a rule the plan's decision changes.
test: Run the draft check on this plan at its signed head: it should name .oxlintrc.json, oxlint-plugins/README.md, .glossary/TERMS.md and the lead skill's step 9.
